For the Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) : Mr. Shailendra Jit, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Achinto Sen, A.P.P.
 ----
 04/Dated: 13th December, 2023  1. Heard the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Korrah P.S. Case No.182 of 2023, registered for the offence under Sections 366(A)/376 of the IPC & Sections 3/4 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-III-cum-Spl. Judge, POCSO Act, Hazaribag.
3. Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the complaint petition has been filed in the year 2019 and on that basis, the F.I.R has been lodged on 06.07.2023.
In the meantime, the parties have got married and there was a case lodged under section 498A of the IPC, in which, he has already been bailed out.
The matrimonial dispute has been aggravated.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
5. Considering the above facts, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to surrender in the court below within four weeks Govind Kumar Mehta @ Govind Prasad Mehta vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 13 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115565579/
